title: Principal Service Platform Engineer
description:
Your impact

We are seeking a skilled satellite communications engineer to join our Network Engineering team. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining satellite communication networks for optimal performance and reliability. The ideal candidate will have experience with iDirect Velocity platforms, hiSky IoT solutions, and satellite broadband systems. Responsibilities include service design requirement analysis, lab testing, evaluation, and creating technical documentation. You will establish best practices for asset management, performance monitoring, and security, collaborate with stakeholders, mentor junior team members, and support training environments for deployment and operations teams.

What you will do

  • Design, develop, and deploy satellite communication systems using iDirect Velocity and hiSky IoT platforms.
  • Configure and optimize iDirect Velocity hubs and modems for high-throughput satellite (HTS) networks.
  • Integrate hiSky Smartellite terminals for IoT applications, ensuring seamless connectivity and data transmission.
  • Understand link budget analysis, network planning, and capacity management to support broadband services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including provisioning and operations engineers, to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for system configurations, operational procedures, and technical support.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies in satellite communications to recommend innovative solutions.
  • Perform engineering calculations using standard principles, theories, concepts, and techniques.
  • Work with stakeholders to deploy Intelsat’s platforms and solutions to PoPs and teleports.
  • Collaborate with project managers on technical scope, schedule, budget, and resource needs.
  • Provide leadership to mentor and coach team members.
  • Enhance training materials and deliver ongoing training to operations team members.

Your required experience/skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline, and is registered with the Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Agronomia (CREA) with at least five years of network and/or systems.
  • Experience configuring and managing iDirect Velocity platforms, including hub systems and modems.
  • Experience with hiSky IoT solutions, particularly Smartellite terminals and associated applications.
  • Good understanding of satellite communication protocols, standards, and network management systems.
  • Ability to perform accurate link budget analysis and satellite network planning.
  • Familiarity with RF communication systems design and testing.
  • Knowledge of system hub components, VSAT Terminals, and VSAT Antennas.
  • Familiarity with ancillary technologies supporting telecommunication networks, such as management and metric gathering tools (Rest-API, SNMP, Netflow), packet capturing tools, and automation tools.
  • Knowledge of operating systems, including Linux, Debian, Unix, and related OS.
  • Must be able and willing to travel domestically and internationally up to 25%.
  • Must be able and willing to perform physical support activities (e.g. cable tracing/running and racking, stacking, replacing and installing hardware) as needed.
  • Ability to interact with Intelsat upstream and downstream teams to define detailed Statement of Work (SOW) documentation.

Your success in this role will look like:

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

It would be nice if you had:

  • Knowledge of IP routing protocols, including but not limited to BGP, EVPN, OSPF, RIP-2.
  • Knowledge of switching technologies, including but not limited to IGMP, 802.XX, Gigabit Ethernet, 10G Ethernet, VXLAN, VLAN/Trunking (802.1q and ISL).
  • Experience with system deployments.
  • Knowledge of RF (C Band, Ku Band, and Ka Band), IF, L-Band, and RF systems and teleport technologies.
  • Knowledge of various modulation and coding schemes for DVB-S, DVB-S2, and DVB-S2X.
  • Scripting/coding skills.

How we support you:

  • Hybrid work environment offering up to two days per week work from home (for eligible positions)
  • Development opportunities supporting professional growth championed by our dedicated Learning & Development team. 20-25% of our positions are hired internally!
  • Ways to get involved: satellite launch parties, company connect events, charitable activities, team social events and recognition programs.
  • Wide range of benefits and perks to help you stay healthy, happy, and productive. These include paid leave programs, medical, tuition reimbursement, and retirement benefits, employee wellness offerings, and more!

These benefits are designed to support your overall well-being and help you succeed in your role.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Intelsat is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based upon race,color, religion, sex, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

While it is important to note that meeting the minimum qualifications is a fundamental requirement for consideration, if you are enthusiastic about this role and are unsure how well your experience aligns with these requirements, we encourage you to apply. Our recruitment team will assess your application and determine if your skills and qualifications meet the essential criteria for this role or whether there might be another role within our organization that is a better match.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
Join to apply for the Human Resources Generalist role at GSCF

Join to apply for the Human Resources Generalist role at GSCF

GSCF is a leading fintech company in the working capital finance space, serving some of the largest tech manufacturers globally. By funding, structuring and servicing accounts receivables portfolios for our customers, we help companies get the most out of their working capital. We help our customers grow their sales, strengthen their balance sheets and eliminate risk.

Our formation in 2021 gives us a start-up culture and mindset, while our origins bring deep industry knowledge, extensive specialized expertise and geographic reach across 59 countries. Despite being a new player in our space, GSCF serviced more than $60 billion in tech accounts receivables volumes in 2021. We are wholly owned and funded by Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager, which provides us with a large and flexible funding pool, significant relationships and strategic guidance. We are a fintech start-up that packs a heavyweight punch.

Our field, global working capital finance, represents a $5.5 trillion total addressable market that is expected to grow an additional 50% by 2026, driven by increased supply chain complexity, digitization of the invoicing process and growing demand for longer payment terms. Our aim is to become the global leader in the working capital finance space.

GSCF is a global employer with more than 300 employees across 20+ countries.

The Role

The rapidly emerging fintech sector presents a world of HR opportunities and challenges. GSCF is an ambitious scale-up which demands a lot of its employees, requiring them to be highly skilled, agile, quick-thinking, and focused. Our HR team plays a crucial role to attract the right candidates and provide support during the employee’s employment journey. You will be part of a global HR team which consists of great professionals spread around the world (Malaysia, Hungary, the Netherlands, Switzerland, and the United States), who are very committed to the success of GSCF and its employees.

We're on a mission to create an amazing workplace experience across South America! As part of our global HR team, you'll be the go-to person in Rio for all HR Operations related activities. A day is never the same because you manage all HR Operations related activities from onboarding to offboarding and everything in between. But you’ll never be alone, your global HR colleagues have your back. If you're passionate about people and love making a difference, this role is for you!

How You Will Make an Impact

Payroll and Benefits Wizardry

· Ensure everyone gets paid accurately and on time.

· Build and maintain a great relationship with our payroll vendor.

· Keep us compliant with local payroll regulations and tax laws.

· Liaison with Health and Benefits broker to ensure compliance with local requirements.

HR Operations Guru

· Manage day-to-day HR operations, from employee records to benefits administration to HRIS administration.

· Be the first point of contact for employees and managers in Brazil, providing guidance on HR policies and procedures.

· Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes.

· Maintain our time recording system and manage holidays and absences.

· Monitor benefits and collaborate with HR colleagues to review and renew.

· Ensure employee safety and welfare.

· Support disciplinary actions or underperformance cases when needed.

· Work with Treasury and Tax to ensure timely payments.

· Knowledge of local laws and regulations including promotions, compensation, and terminations and staying informed of changes or new initiatives.

· General knowledge and working with a Union (Sindicato).

· Manage the office space and create and maintain a healthy office environment.

Recruitment Rockstar

· Support managers and HR colleagues during the recruitment process, including job postings, coordinating interviews, managing candidate communications, and budget monitoring.

· Liaise with recruiting agencies to ensure effective collaboration.

· Onboard and train new joiners.

Policy and Project Champion

· Implement global HR policies and procedures in Brazil.

· Adapt global policies to comply with local laws and cultural nuances.

· Communicate and train employees in new policies and procedures.

· Collaborate with the global HR team to roll out new policies and procedures.

· Participate in global HR projects.

Data Dynamo

· Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee data in the HR information system.

· Generate HR reports to support decision-making.

· Keep data trackers updated and ensure data integrity.

What You Bring to the Team:

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

· Fluency in Portuguese and English, both spoken and written. Spanish language skills are a plus.

· Minimum 3 years of HR Generalist experience including Brazilian payroll.

· Legal experience a plus.

· Experience in a multinational company.

· Analytical and strong eye for detail.

· Pro-active and can-do approach.

· Warm personality with excellent interpersonal communication skills.

· Ability to multi-task and effectively manage own time.

· Great team-player with the flexibility to succeed and drive results in a fast-paced, high-charged environment.

· Ability to think out of the box for solutions.

What's in It for You:

· Competitive salary and benefits.

· You'll be part of and support the growth of our dynamic Rio office.

· An engaged, ambitious and fun group of international HR colleagues with whom you will closely interact.

· Enjoy a hybrid working schedule: this role requires three days in the office.

· Make a real impact on the employee experience in Brazil.

· International work environment with colleagues in 15+ countries.

· A true generalist HR role with a lot of day-to-day dynamics and the possibility to assume more responsibilities if and when ready.

· The opportunity to join a scaled and profitable start-up with the weight and experience of Blackstone behind you.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by law.

Your key objective will be the coordination, production, and SEO optimization of high class content that ranks in Google.

You will become part of an international, highly skilled and dedicated team catering to various user groups, in the broad field of sports betting and Igaming. You will take ownership and responsibility of the websites and products you are working on.

Your main responsibilities as a SEO Content Manager will be:

Coordinate the production of content for several of our top websites & create editorial plan

Optimize content for SEO

Perform keyword studies and develop strategies to address different user groups

Create new content based on business and market priorities

Manage requests to freelancers/writers, proofread their work and provide feedback

Regularly monitor KPIs (rankings, traffic, conversion)

Keep an overview of legal and competitive changes on the market

Joining Better Collective, you will become part of a dream team of talented individuals that play each other well. International environment

description:
Lider de Time - turno da noite, Amazon Logistics

Job ID: 3022654 | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

Quer trabalhar duro, se divertir e fazer história? A Amazon oferece uma oportunidade de carreira única. Nossas equipes de logística transformam a interação com clientes globalmente, enfrentando grandes desafios logísticos.

As equipes de transporte garantem a entrega de pacotes em todo o mundo, encontrando soluções para cumprir nossa promessa aos clientes.

A Amazon Logística busca um(a) Líder de Time para a equipe da AMZL Brasil, na nossa Delivery Station no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Como líder, você supervisionará uma estação de entrega, liderando associados e gerenciando indicadores de desempenho (KPIs). Trabalhará em um ambiente colaborativo, semelhante a uma start-up, onde a inovação é incentivada. É necessário prosperar em ambientes dinâmicos e ambíguos. As principais funções incluem:

  1. Estar presente na estação de entrega, incluindo finais de semana e feriados, pois operamos 24/7.
  2. Criar e promover um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de melhoria em segurança.
  3. Liderar e treinar os associados para oferecer o melhor serviço.
  4. Garantir o atendimento aos pedidos conforme as diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  5. Fornecer informações críticas ao time durante o turno.
  6. Colaborar com suporte e outros departamentos para resolver problemas relacionados a desempenho, segurança, treinamento, entre outros.
  7. Monitorar rotas e atuar proativamente para corrigir desvios, visando superar as expectativas do cliente e controlar custos.
  8. Conduzir reuniões, distribuir tarefas e gerenciar KPIs como despacho pontual e sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia.
  9. Analisar métricas para identificar causas raízes e implementar melhorias rápidas.
  10. Propor soluções simples para problemas complexos, mantendo a qualidade.
  11. Dar suporte na implementação de novos sistemas e processos, coletando feedback.
  12. Utilizar ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações eficientes, garantindo ferramentas adequadas para os associados.
  13. Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções aos departamentos relevantes.

Nossa cultura inclusiva valoriza a diversidade e promove um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor. Se precisar de acomodação para entrevistas ou integração, informe seu recrutador para que possa ser atendido pela equipe responsável.

description:

Join to apply for the Business Services Team Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.
This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.
We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.
This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.
Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.
Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.
Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing
Leadership and accountability
This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.
As a manager, your team would be responsible for

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices
What we are looking for
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Dermage é sinônimo de qualidade e cuidado. Cuidado ao cuidar da pele de verdade, com ativos de alta concentração. Cuidado ao pensar e desenvolver produtos para a pele brasileira há 30 anos, criando fórmulas nas mais variadas texturas e para suas diversas necessidades.
Com criatividade, estudos e muitas pesquisas, a Dermage se tornou uma das marcas de dermocosméticos mais queridinhas das brasileiras. Seus produtos, desenvolvidos com ativos de alta eficácia e sem testes em animais, ganharam posição de destaque, com fórmulas premiadas e indicações de dermatologistas.
De uma pequena sala em Copacabana e poucas fórmulas, para mais de 200 produtos no portfólio e mais de 70 lojas no país, entre próprias e franquias, além da distribuição em farmácias e em grandes multimarcas.
VENHA FAZER PARTE DO NOSSO TIME!
Nossa empresa tem como missão cuidar das pessoas, oferecendo saúde e beleza hoje e sempre.
Buscamos um colaborador que goste de inovação, execução e tenha vontade de fazer diferente!
Se você gosta de desafios, queremos conhecer você!
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responsável pelo processo de gestão de benefícios, incluindo a análise e a atualização contínua das planilhas de controle para assegurar a correta compra mensal de benefícios;

  • Integração de pagamentos no sistema Datasul, garantindo o correto processamento e liberação para o setor financeiro.
  • Análise e gestão do ponto eletrônico, com foco no controle e fechamento do banco de horas;
  • Atuação direta com escritórios contábil e financeiro, assegurando alinhamento de processos e conformidade fiscal e trabalhista;
  • Sólido domínio da legislação trabalhista, aplicando conhecimentos técnicos para garantir práticas alinhadas à legislação e à política interna da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Experiência comprovada na área de Departamento Pessoal, com atuação em rotinas operacionais e legais;
  • Atualização constante em Legislação Trabalhista, incluindo conhecimentos práticos em eSocial, SST (Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho), Consignado e FGTS Digital;
  • Domínio em cálculos trabalhistas, abrangendo férias, rescisões, 13º salário e folha de pagamento;

Role Overview
The Account Executive is tasked with acquiring new clients and expanding existing relationships for a fast-growing web-development studio. Working closely with solution architects, the individual translates business goals into technically sound project proposals and steers each opportunity from first conversation through contract signature.
Day-to-Day Focus
The role begins with targeted outreach to digital-first brands that need custom websites, migrations, or web-app builds. Discovery calls uncover pain points, after which the Account Executive frames scope and budget in language that resonates with both marketing leadership and engineering stakeholders. Internal designers and developers join scoping sessions only after the Account Executive has defined a clear problem statement and timeline. Pipeline data lives in HubSpot; forecasts are updated weekly and reviewed with the Head of Growth. Once projects kick off, the Account Executive stays involved long enough to secure smooth hand-offs and identify expansion opportunities such as feature add-ons or support retainers.
Required Background
A minimum of three years carrying quota at a web-development agency is essential; closed deals of USD 100 K or more demonstrate the necessary credibility. Fluency in core WebDev concepts—responsive design, CMS migrations, headless builds, performance optimization, and CI/CD workflows—allows the individual to converse confidently with CTOs while still speaking plainly to non-technical buyers. Proven command of a modern CRM (HubSpot preferred) and crisp written and verbal communication complete the baseline profile.
Additional Perspective
Familiarity with stacks such as React, Next.js, or Laravel, plus an understanding of agile delivery rhythms, will help set accurate expectations and shorten sales cycles. A network in industries that prize scalable web platforms—e-commerce, SaaS, fintech—offers a strong advantage.
Success Markers
Within six months, the Account Executive is expected to close at least two new web-development projects totaling USD 250 K and to grow one existing client by 20 percent. Forecast accuracy should remain above 90 percent, and pipeline hygiene must meet the studio’s data standards.
Professionals who have already excelled in selling WebDev agency services and who thrive on turning technical capabilities into clear business value are encouraged to apply.

description:
R&D Engineer (Advanced Drilling Systems)

R&D Engineer (Advanced Drilling Systems)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Our client is expanding its R&D team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and is seeking highly motivated engineers to contribute to the development of cutting-edge drilling technologies for offshore deepwater applications. This opportunity centers on innovation, new product development, and testing—not operations or maintenance.

We are hiring across multiple disciplines to support core technology areas including downhole power generation, coiled tubing/drillstring development, subsea and high-voltage electronics, and advanced testing/integration systems. Ideal candidates will have a solid background in research and development (R&D), system design, and engineering analysis, with hands-on experience in product development for high-reliability environments.

Areas of Expertise We’re Looking For:

  • Mechanical Engineering: Experience in drilling motors, downhole turbines, or subsea pumps for power generation; coiled tubing/drillstring development; familiarity with manufacturing, machining, and supplier coordination.
  • Mechanical Design/Drafting: Proficiency in generating manufacturing drawings for complex drilling or subsea components and coordinating with manufacturers/suppliers.
  • Integration/Test Engineering: Engineers with a mechanical or electrical/electronics focus, experienced in downhole or subsea systems, sensor integration, test equipment design, and data acquisition.

Electrical Engineering:

  • Plasma/High-Voltage Electronics: High-voltage systems for plasma-based drilling. Relevant experience in military, defense, pulsed power, lasers, or nuclear sectors is a plus.
  • Subsea/Downhole Electronics: Development of high-power electronics and embedded systems for subsea applications.

Software/Firmware/Controls Engineering:

  • Firmware Development: Development and validation of high-reliability firmware for oil & gas environments.
  • Controls Engineering: Experience with PLC programming, real-time control systems, test equipment design, and HIL testing. Familiarity with MATLAB, dSPACE, or SPEEDGOAT is advantageous.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute R&D projects in alignment with technical specifications, timelines, and budget
  • Design, test, and commercialize innovative drilling tools and systems for offshore use
  • Implement processes and tools that drive excellence and innovation in product development
  • Collaborate with global engineering teams, leadership, and suppliers to ensure successful integration and delivery
  • Manage technical risks and ensure compliance with HSEQ and regulatory standards
  • Produce detailed engineering documentation including drawings, calculations, and technical reports
  • Foster a culture of collaboration and innovation within the R&D team
  • Represent the company’s technical work at conferences to reinforce its position as a technology leader

Our client is growing its footprint in Brazil to address the region’s unique energy challenges. With a focus on offshore and deepwater solutions, the local team is instrumental in developing next-generation drilling systems tailored to this critical market. They work in close partnership with global collaborators and local operators to bring advanced solutions to life.

In this role, you’ll engage in transformative R&D efforts alongside teams in Brazil, Europe, and the USA—contributing to innovations across both conventional and renewable energy domains.

description:

Join to apply for the Senior Engineering Manager- Ubuntu role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager to lead the engineering team that delivers the essential components of Ubuntu - our system startup, compilers, language runtimes and toolchains, as well as networking and storage config and management. This is a fast-paced, problem-solving, highly technical role operating at the core of Linux server systems.
As an Engineering Manager on the Foundations team, you will be at the heart of driving Ubuntu. Working at the unique intersection of the open source ecosystem, and enterprise technologists.
In this pivotal position, you'll lead and inspire your team of engineers, to take Ubuntu to new heights. We are looking for someone with a deep understanding of Linux and Ubuntu with a passion for exceptional leadership. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery and drive your team on strategy and execution.
Location: Globally remote
The role entails

  • Lead and grow a team of distributed engineers
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles through active and hands on leadership
  • Be responsible for planning, estimation and execution
  • Work with product management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leadership teams
  • Drive the advancement and adoption of the latest software development practices
  • Design, embrace and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values
  • Engage with other teams at Canonical to ensure alignment on product architecture and roadmaps
  • Work from home while meeting in person for company sprints. Sprints are typically twice a year for 1-2 weeks.
What we are looking for in you
  • You have worked extensively with Linux distributions, and are experienced with packaging technologies (e.g. deb, rpm, other)
  • You have demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • High quality software engineering knowledge in one or more of: Linux system architecture, boot process, Java/GCC/Python/Rust/Go toolchains, ARM and/or RISC-V
  • Engagement with open source communities and processes
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, reconhecemos e celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time.

Estamos com uma vaga aberta para Gerente de Projetos (PMO) - Sênior , que atuará dentro do nosso time de Delivery, sendo responsável por:

title: Project Manager I, Operations
description:
Project Manager I, Operations may be assigned multiple projects depending on the complexity or will oversee the execution of a phase(s) for a larger project. Responsible for all aspects of the project over the entire project life (initiate, plan, execute, control, close) to meet business objectives through the utilization of project management methodologies.This includes but is not limited to; coordinating a project team, developing a schedule, and monitoring the project process to ensure the quality and timely completion of project(s).

What You Will Do:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects
  • Develop schedules/timelines/cost plans that support the business objectives, established budgets, resources, and project deliverables for each project
  • Coordinate day-to-day execution of the overall project delivery process.
  • Assure projects are executed within the approved budget and schedule and in accordance with company Quality requirements
  • Managing risks and issues and taking corrective measurements
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports related to the project.
  • Managing stakeholders’ communication and preparing communications for management and updates.
  • Managing the main project documentation from project initiation through completion in accordance with the process instruction.
  • Ensure that invoices are properly prepared in accordance with contractual terms and are issued to clients in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and submit time charge records and expense reports in a timely manner in accordance with company procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Typically requires a minimum of 1-3 years of project management-related experience in a lead role.
  • Typically requires a Bachelor of Science and at least one year of experience in the maritime and/or offshore industry.
  • Preferably holds a Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) or a general certification in Project Management

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to effectively speak and write English fluently
  • Experience and knowledge of project management methodologies and techniques
  • Ability to work positively with a wide range of individuals involved in the project
  • The ability to identify, analyze and solve complex and unique project-related problems.
  • Ability to organize, plan, monitor, and control project contractual requirements, budgets, schedules, and technical work.
  • Proficient with PM tools and software (i.e. MS Office and MS Project)
  • Possesses good communication skills both orally and in writing technical issues to personnel who may or may not be in related technical fields.
  • The desire and ability to work as a member of a team.
  • Realization of financial aspects of approved business plans and budgets pertaining to the project.
  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships:

Reports to a Senior Project Manager, Program Manager, Director or Executive level position

Working Conditions:

Work is primarily sedentary; exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move object

Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CFD Engineer to join our innovative engineering team at ABS Consulting. This role is critical in advancing our computational fluid dynamics (CFD) capabilities, driving the development of cutting-edge simulations to optimize product performance and efficiency across various applications.
What You Will Do

  • Lead the development and implementation of CFD methodologies to analyze complex fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical reactions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall engineering goals.
  • Design and execute simulation plans, including grid generation, model setup, and validation against experimental data.
  • Utilize advanced post-processing techniques to analyze simulation results, identifying key insights and communicating findings effectively to stakeholders.
  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in CFD technology, integrating new tools and methodologies into the engineering workflow.
  • Performs advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modeling for quantitative risk analysis, including Fire and Explosion analysis, Gas Detectors allocation, Flame Detection Allocation, Exhaust and Vent dispersion, Smoke and Gas Dispersion, Flare Radiation Analysis, and Helideck Turbulence Analysis
  • Assists qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Suports Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) to ensure compliance with safety standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Implements and maintains ABS Quality System requirements relative to responsibilities after undergoing ABS Quality System training.
  • Drafts technically accurate and timely reports, and responses to letters, faxes, and other forms of communication.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience:
  • Master’s in chemical, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field with a strong emphasis on fluid dynamics and experience on O&G projects.
  • Experience in CFD analysis, with proficiency in industry-standard software such as FLACS, KFX, CFX , ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or COMSOL.
  • Solid understanding of turbulence modeling, heat transfer, and multiphase flow dynamics.
  • Experience in qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis.
  • Experience in Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA).
  • Familiarity with Process Safety Management (PSM) principles.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian regulations (e.g., Petrobras Safety Guidelines, ANP, NRs) is a plus.
  • Professional or chartered engineering license
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills).
  • Good command of the English language with the ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Expertise in computational fluid dynamics simulation and modeling techniques.
  • Proficiency in software tools for mesh generation, simulation, and post-processing.
  • Understanding of numerical methods and algorithms used in CFD.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving capacity.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced, high-demand environments with strong stress management skills.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.
It Would Be Nice If You Have:
  • Experience in applying CFD to aerospace, automotive, or energy systems.
  • Experience in scripting or programming languages (Python, MATLAB) to automate processes and enhance simulation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and parallel processing techniques.
  • Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conference proceedings.
Reporting Relationships:
The incumbent reports to a senior level engineer or technical manager. This position does not have any direct reports.
